name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth cursor
description: A drawn cursor that springs after the pointer, tilts into its direction of travel, squashes with speed and swaps to a hand over anything clickable. Position and angle are both springs integrated at a fixed 360Hz substep, so the motion is the same at 60Hz and 144Hz, and no React state is involved.
